gloss: even more, all the more, noticeably

definitions.gloss: even more, all the more, noticeably
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something has increased or improved by a noticeable degree compared to before. Emphasizes a step up from a previous level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧になって{一段|いちだん}と⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It got noticeably colder when autumn arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一段|いちだん}と⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧になった。
examples.english: Thanks to practice, she became even more skillful.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライトアップ→ライトアップ：11220_raitoappu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一段|いちだん}と⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The illuminated autumn leaves were all the more beautiful.

notes:
{一段|いちだん}と means "by one step more" and indicates a noticeable increase or improvement compared to a previous state. Typically modifies adjectives or verbs expressing change.

COMPOUND: ⟦{一段|いちだん}→一段：08951_ichidan⟧ (one step/level) + ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (adverbial particle)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一段|いちだん}と⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get noticeably colder
- {一段|いちだん}と⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧: even more beautiful
- {一段|いちだん}と⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become even more skillful
- {一段|いちだん}と⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become even stricter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- さらに: furthermore, even more (neutral, also used in lists)
- ⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧: more and more, increasingly (emphasizes ongoing progression)
- いっそう: all the more (slightly more formal, often literary)

The key distinction: {一段|いちだん}と emphasizes a noticeable jump to a higher level, while ⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ emphasizes continuous gradual increase.
